name: Frame Counter
description: Shows the current frame of the level while you play.

enabled.name: Show Frame Counter
enabled.description: Toggle the frame counter on or off.

show-prefix.name: Show "Frame:" Prefix
show-prefix.description: Display the text <cy>Frame:</c> before the number.

corner.name: Screen Corner
corner.description: Which corner of the screen the counter appears in.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: Opacity of the counter text (0 = invisible, 255 = solid).

fps.name: Frames Per Second
fps.description: Frame rate used to convert level time into frames. <cy>240</c> matches GD's default physics steps, <cy>60</c> matches normal visual frames.
